description: The linter the vite react template's lint script runs. Built from the oxc monorepo at the oxlint_v<version> tag, cross-checked against the release's npm provenance attestation. The features are upstream's own release line for this binding, build-napi-release: --release --features allocator. Versions: releases before 1.45.0 ship the oxlint executable (@oxlint/<platform>), not a napi binding, so there is no .node for this cdylib to stand in for (min). 1.45.0 has no oxlint_v1.45.0 tag upstream (git ls-remote), and 1.61.1 lists no optionalDependencies at all (deprecated upstream: accidentally published) and has neither tag nor attestation; both are denied.
